messages.en: Go check Cosmo Room.
Was it a little too much to post on the official account, so you put it here instead?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋ Something else will be posted on the official account.
Something that'll get everyone worked up.
I look pretty handsome today.
I'm going to take lots of pictures.
I even bought more storage recently,
and brought my digital camera here, too.
But I only used it once at the airport
and haven't taken it out since.
I wish I could be as dedicated to taking photos as everyone else.
Seeing the members stay up to take pictures even when they're tired,
I have so much respect for them.
Did you pack that Toronto T shirt, too, Hayeon?
Of course!
I'm planning to use it as workout clothes during the tour.
I went for a one hour run by myself again today.
I wore that shirt.

messages.ko: 나 투어할때 호텔에서 항상 혼자 헬스장 갔었는데
messages.en: Whenever I was on tour, I'd always go to the hotel gym by myself.
But on the last tour,
I was eating nonstop and working out on top of that,
so I ended up bulking up ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I'm really going to get it right this time.
No, this time I'm going for Slim Hayeon.
For Bulked Up Hayeon, go watch the Come True R.P.
Aw, but I like Bulked Up Hayeon.
You only like her because her shoulders got broader.
They're practically as broad as a swimmer's.
Before I work out, I really don't feel like doing it,
but afterward, that refreshing feeling
and sense of accomplishment
are what keep me doing it.
But strangely, I never work out when I'm in Korea.

messages.ko: 더 많은 음식을 먹기 위해서만 하는 줄 알았어요.
messages.en: I thought you only worked out so you could eat more.
So that's the image you have of me.
Noted.

messages.ko: 운동할 때 듣는 노래 추천 좀
messages.en: Recommend some songs to listen to while working out.
I seriously can't work out without music.
I need to listen to some second generation K pop
to really get into it and have a good workout.
Any song will do.
Are there any songs you've been listening to a lot lately?
I'll give you a song recommendation.
Crush - 'seesaw'
It's such a good song.
You really love Crush's songs.
He takes up half of my playlist.
You have to sing 'Wobble' for us next time.
I just need to practice, right?
Huh?
Kim Chaewon just went in to take a shower,
and she put on 'Wobble'?
Is she listening in on my Cosmo Talk?
Ah, this is hilarious.
The timing of this!
You two...
Are you sharing the same neurons?
But seriously, this actually happens.
We always show up with the same hairstyle and concept in mind on the same day.
Whoever doesn't want to match ends up changing theirs.
Usually, when I'm the one who gets ready first and that happens,
I look at Kim Chaewon and
yell at her to stop copying me.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㄹㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ
I guess we just have similar tastes.
Speaking of something scary,
I was alone in my room earlier,
getting ready with a scary video playing in the background,
when suddenly, the bathroom faucet turned on by itself.
Can a faucet really turn on by itself?
I immediately turned off the video and put on some music.
That was me.
Come out!
I know you're in there! Come out!!!!
But I was genuinely scared.
Still, I figured something must have accidentally turned on,
so I just carried on, filming Reels and having fun.
The stuff I uploaded to Cosmo Room was filmed then, too.
Oh, were you filming along with me from behind?

messages.ko: 근데 난 점점 귀신 안믿게 되는게
messages.en: But I'm gradually starting to believe in ghosts less and less.

messages.ko: 한국에 있을때 귀신 머 막 무서워하다가
messages.en: When I'm in Korea, I get so scared of ghosts and all that,
but when I come to the US,
it's funny to think a ghost would follow me all the way here.

messages.ko: 미국에서 보는 귀신은 또 미국 사람귀신으로 보이려나
messages.en: And would the ghosts I see in America be American ghosts, too?
Thinking about things like that
just makes me less scared.
I wonder, when people see ghosts in other countries,
do they see ghosts of that country's nationality?
I'm curious.
A Korean ghost latched onto your back and came along with you.
It must've been squashed against your back for all 13 hours of the flight.
Poor thing..
Poor ghost must've been terrified of the turbulence, too ㅠㅠ
Apparently, it was holding my hand.
So don't worry about that.
Wait, I wanna be a ghost, too.
What kind of thing is that ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Why would you want to become a ghost?
I'm already Y/n's, though.
Heh.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
Get that smile off your face.
I can see everything.
ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I'm putting on a face mask right now,
and a lip mask, too.
Guess what I'm saying.
I love you.
Love you, too~
ㅋㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I just wanted to hear you say you love me,
so I baited you into saying it.
Is it time for a Haranghae session? It's been a while!
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ Haranghae~
What are you going to do now?
As for what I'm going to do today...
I'm going to sleep~
Because it's nighttime where I am.
Long distance is hard....
Just hang in there a little longer.
Or you could just fly over here ❤️
Have a good day today!
I'm going to sleep nowww.

messages.ko: WAV in the Americas good night
messages.en: WAV in the Americas good night
Haranghae ❤️
